comments.body:
Yes, I think this is a good small additive change.

The existing pattern is [`install-sepo.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/install-sepo.yml): it has an `agent-command` field with a fixed value, currently `@sepo-agent /install`. For “ask sepo”, I’d add a new issue form at:

[` .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ask-sepo.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/tree/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE)

Suggested shape:

```yaml
name: Ask Sepo
description: Ask Sepo a question about this repository
title: "Ask Sepo: "
labels: ["agent"]
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: agent-command
    attributes:
      label: Agent command
      description: Leave this line unchanged so Sepo can route the request.
      value: "@sepo-agent /answer"
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: question
    attributes:
      label: Question
      description: What should Sepo answer?
      placeholder: Ask a repository question or request plan-only guidance.
    validations:
      required: true
```

I’d also add a focused assertion near the existing issue-template checks in [`envelope.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts) so the form stays parseable and keeps the `@sepo-agent /answer` routing line.

So: yes, implement it as a new issue template, with the extra fixed command line rather than changing router behavior.

another small question: 

when I am on mobile, i can see that these two templates requires opening an external webapge? how so? can we make it easier?

That looks like GitHub Mobile behavior, not something in our templates.

This repo currently has only YAML issue forms: `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/agent-goal.yml` and `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/install-sepo.yml`. There is no `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml` with `contact_links`, so we are not intentionally sending users to an external site. GitHub’s docs describe YAML issue forms as web form fields, and the mobile app often opens those in the GitHub web flow/browser instead of a fully native composer: https://docs.github.com/en/communities/using-templates-to-encourage-useful-issues-and-pull-requests/syntax-for-issue-forms

We can make it easier, though. I’d do two things:

1. Add the `Ask Sepo` template as the simple YAML form we discussed, with only:
   - fixed `@sepo-agent /answer`
   - one required question textarea

2. Add a mobile-friendly direct link somewhere prominent, like README/docs, that bypasses the template chooser and opens a prefilled issue:

```text
https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/new?labels=agent&title=Ask%20Sepo%3A%20&body=%40sepo-agent%20%2Fanswer%0A%0A
```

GitHub supports prefilled issue URLs with `title`, `body`, and `labels`: https://docs.github.com/en/issues/tracking-your-work-with-issues/using-issues/creating-an-issue#creating-an-issue-from-a-url-query

So we probably cannot stop GitHub Mobile from using the web flow for issue forms, but we can make “ask Sepo” one tap with the command already inserted.

I checked the template difference. The practical distinction is:

- **Markdown issue templates** (`.md`) open the normal GitHub issue composer with prefilled text. They are simple, easy to edit, work well with direct prefilled issue URLs, and tend to be more mobile-friendly.
- **YAML issue forms** (`.yml`) open GitHub's structured form UI. They support required fields, typed inputs, dropdowns, and validation, but they are more like a web form and GitHub Mobile may route users through a browser/web flow.

For the current Sepo templates, I think the simple ones should probably be Markdown by default. If a template is mostly just inserting a Sepo command plus one or two text fields, YAML is adding complexity without much benefit.

Suggested direction:

1. **Ask Sepo** should be Markdown:
   - prefill `@sepo-agent /answer`
   - include a simple `Question` section
   - label with `agent`

2. **Install Sepo** could also be Markdown:
   - prefill `@sepo-agent /install`
   - include a `Target public repository URL` section
   - include optional notes
   - Sepo can ask for missing info if the user leaves something out

3. **Agent goal** is the only one where YAML may still be worth keeping, because it has multiple structured planning fields and required success criteria. But even that could be converted to Markdown if mobile simplicity matters more than field validation.

So the rule of thumb I would use is:

> Use Markdown templates for simple Sepo command issues. Use YAML issue forms only when we truly need required fields or structured validation.

I think the “external webpage” part is GitHub Mobile’s handling of YAML issue forms, not something we configured.

In this repo, both current templates are YAML issue forms: [`agent-goal.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/agent-goal.yml) and [`install-sepo.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/install-sepo.yml). There is no `config.yml` with `contact_links`, so we are not intentionally sending people to an external page. GitHub documents issue forms as web-style form templates, and its issue URL query support is the better escape hatch for simple mobile flows: https://docs.github.com/en/issues/tracking-your-work-with-issues/using-issues/creating-an-issue#creating-an-issue-from-a-url-query

My recommendation: keep the YAML templates, but add “quick links” for mobile that open a prefilled issue composer directly.

For ask:

```text
https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/new?title=Ask%20Sepo%3A%20&body=%40sepo-agent%20%2Fanswer%0A%0A
```

For install:

```text
https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/new?title=Install%20Sepo%20into%20target%20repository&body=%40sepo-agent%20%2Finstall%0A%0ATarget%20repository%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fowner%2Frepo%0A%0ANotes%3A%20
```

I’d put those in `README.md` and the setup docs next to the existing `?template=install-sepo.yml` link. That gives desktop users the structured form, while mobile users get a lower-friction “open composer with the Sepo command already inserted” path.

We should simplify based on this ?

Yes. I’d simplify, with one caveat: keep `agent-goal` as YAML for now.

Current state:
- [`install-sepo.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/install-sepo.yml) is a simple command-plus-two-fields form.
- [`agent-goal.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/agent-goal.yml) is genuinely structured: goal, why, success criteria, strategy, subgoals, related work.
- Existing docs link directly to `?template=install-sepo.yml` in [`README.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/README.md), [`docs index`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/index.md), and [`install-existing-repository.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/setup/install-existing-repository.md).
- Tests currently assert the install YAML form in [`envelope.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts).

Recommended implementation:

1. Add `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ask-sepo.md` with Markdown front matter:
   - `name: Ask Sepo`
   - `about: Ask Sepo a question about this repository`
   - `title: "Ask Sepo: "`
   - `labels: agent`
   - body starts with `@sepo-agent /answer`, then a `## Question` section.

2. Convert `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/install-sepo.yml` to `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/install-sepo.md`:
   - same title and `agent` label
   - body starts with `@sepo-agent /install`
   - include `## Target public repository URL` and `## Notes`.

3. Keep `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/agent-goal.yml` unchanged unless we decide mobile simplicity matters more than required planning fields.

4. Update links from `?template=install-sepo.yml` to `?template=install-sepo.md`.

5. Update `envelope.test.ts` so it checks the Markdown template front matter/body instead of parsing the install YAML form, and add a matching assertion for `ask-sepo.md`.

This matches GitHub’s template model: Markdown templates can still set default title and labels via YAML front matter, while YAML issue forms are better reserved for structured web-form validation. GitHub’s docs also note issue forms use customizable web form fields, which is exactly the piece creating friction on mobile: https://docs.github.com/en/communities/using-templates-to-encourage-useful-issues-and-pull-requests/configuring-issue-templates-for-your-repository

I’d approve this direction.
